root_cause_label: Incomplete Account Number Discovery Leading to Missing Typo Variant BUS-30g01
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent's initial grep found only 6 rows by company name substring, causing it to assume those 3 account numbers were exhaustive and hardcode them, permanently missing the BUS-30g01 typo-variant transaction which was never detected during subsequent superficial verification.
t_err_evidence: Step 3 awk command hardcodes account number pattern /BUS-(30001|30999|35001)/ derived solely from step 2's limited grep results, never searching for account number typo variants (e.g., BUS-30g01); the false premise that those 3 accounts are exhaustive is encoded into the filter.
t_commit_evidence: Step 3 writes output.json with the incomplete filter; all subsequent steps (4-10) either re-verify the same incomplete output or regenerate it with the same filter logic, so the missing BUS-30g01 row is never added.
trigger_explanation: The agent ran a grep on company name ('north west capital') in step 2 which returned 6 rows and revealed 3 account numbers (BUS-30001, BUS-30999, BUS-35001). The agent assumed this grep was exhaustive, acting on the unverified premise that all relevant account numbers had been found, without considering that a typo in the account number field (BUS-30g01) would not be caught by a company-name substring search.
